# LLM Agent Design Architecture

> Design of agents whose inference core is a foundation model (LLM). A book-form site on the five layers (Doctrine / Agent / Skills / Memory / MCP), placement of knowledge, and strategy for rollout. Not a product manual for a specific harness.

Site: https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/
Japanese: https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/ja/
GitHub: https://github.com/shuji-bonji/ai-agent-architecture

## Book core (read in order)

- [Preface — Questions and scope](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/preface): Questions the book answers, five layers, exclusions, structure
- [I.1 Constraint summary](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-1/constraints): Limits an LLM already has; mechanisms out of scope
- [II.1 Five layers](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-2/layers): Doctrine / Agent / Skills / Memory / MCP — who owns what
- [II.2 Placement](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-2/placement): Where knowledge and authority sit across the layers
- [III.1 Doctrine](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-3/doctrine): Standing judgments that constrain the agent
- [III.2 Memory](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-3/memory): What is retained, retrieved, and forgotten
- [IV.1 Patterns](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-4/patterns): Design patterns in agent systems
- [IV.2 Limits](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-4/limits): Working within AI limits without pretending they vanish
- [IV.3 Physical world](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-4/physical): Same five layers when robots and sensors are in the loop
- [IV.4 Prompt decomposition](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/part-4/prompt-decomposition): Breaking prompts along ownership boundaries

## Layer entries (Part III practice)

- [What is Skills?](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/skills/what-is-skills): Packaged procedures the agent can invoke
- [What is MCP?](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/mcp/what-is-mcp): Protocol for tools and external context (client-driven)
- [Agents](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/agents/): Agent / sub-agent / A2A entry

## Strategy and rollout (Part IV)

- [Composition Patterns](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/composition-patterns)
- [MCP Family](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/mcp-family)
- [Hooks](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/hooks): Execution boundary on the harness side — not a sixth layer
- [Harness Engineering Mapping](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/harness-engineering-mapping)
- [Loop Engineering](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/loop-engineering)
- [Proposal vs Binding](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/proposal-and-binding)
- [Permission vs Authority](https://shuji-bonji.github.io/ai-agent-architecture/strategy/permission-vs-authority)
